Native-only additions documented: clampToStep (snaps a raw drag value to the step grid relative to min then clamps to [min,max], the behaviour an <input type='range'> enforced natively); two once-created PanResponders reading a mutable stateRef (so they are never recreated per render, mirroring the Lightbox port); ACCESSIBILITY_ACTIONS + THUMB_HIT_SLOP constants; per-thumb testIDs `${testID}-low` / `${testID}-high` (only when a wrapper testID is supplied) following the SortControl port's `${testId}-field`/`-direction` precedent so each thumb is individually queryable. PageUp/PageDown (~10%) and Home/End keyboard shortcuts from the APG pattern have no native gesture/key analog and are dropped — increment/decrement covers the primary step interaction.

No DOM <input>/<div>/<span>, react-i18next, cn/clsx/tailwind-merge, Tailwind classes, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported; only react (useCallback/useId/useMemo/useRef) + react-native (PanResponder/StyleSheet/View + a11y/layout/style types) primitives and the existing native AppText + theme tokens are used.
